data_fields.name: respawn_jitter
data_fields.donor_constant: uniform whole seconds in [0, max - min)

data_fields.name: presence_near_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 13 (Manhattan tile distance counted as in view)

data_fields.name: presence_far_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 17 (beyond this never in view; 14 to 17 uses a second test)

data_fields.name: map_monster_amount
data_fields.donor_constant: default 1 when the map row sets none; 0 when the map has no row

data_fields.name: respawn_screen
data_fields.donor_constant: boolean; true skips the presence gate

best_idea: Before a monster appears, pick a point at random in the zone's box (or near a fixed point), refuse any point a player can see, and retry the same spawn after 3 seconds with a new point, with the respawn delay as a fixed minimum plus a uniform whole-second jitter.
decision_why: The presence gate and the min-plus-jitter respawn timer fit row 23 directly, but the donor's view test is the client's screen shape and our camera is client-only, so the server must use its own range; the donor's band test and its unchecked fallbacks do not port.
acceptance: Server test: a monster area spawn whose first random point has a player within 13 tiles is retried after 3000 ms and placed only at a point with no player within 13 tiles; with respawn_screen set it is placed at the first passable point even in view; with min 10 and max 20 s, 10,000 draws give delays in [10, 19] s.
